basic_info.description: Major price reduction and new improvements, including new wood laminate floors in bedrooms! Fantastic opportunity to own a condo in the heart of San Francisco!  This sunny, 2 Bedroom, 2 Bath home is an incredible value! Not a Co-op and not a BMR! This great Cathedral Hill location is across from Jefferson Square Park, near Japantown, Hayes Valley, and Civic Center. It is freshly painted & ready to move in, with new LED lighting, and NEW flooring in bedrooms!  The bathroom has a bathtub + a walk-in shower. Spacious kitchen offers solid wood cabinetry and granite countertops.  3 closets .  Enjoy sipping coffee on the adjacent patio or in front of your balcony overlooking the beautiful greenery of the City Park and dog play area. A shared big rooftop terrace with a nice view is ideal for relaxing or entertaining. Abundant outdoor spaces. Included is a parking space in 4-car garage. Ideal location near the Opera Plaza, Trader Joe's, vibrant cafes, fitness centers, and theaters. FREE use of Laundry equipment shared with only 3 other units. Walk & Transit scores: 95+  Bike score: 88/100
